P02 Admin Auth & RBAC
item.description:
Admin authentication, 2FA, refresh, session revoke, RBAC, lockout.

Run order:
1. Run '00 Login all roles' to populate tokens
2. Run folders 01-07 in order

Convention:
- Never log out the main SA session (adminSa_token) except in 07 (last request).
- All admin routes use Bearer {{adminXX_token}}.
- 2fa/verify and 2fa/setup do NOT use a Bearer header — they take mfaToken in the body.
